#load all libaries required for this script

```{r} 
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(openxlsx)

# colour palette 
my_cols <- brewer.pal(n=5, "Spectral")


## feature and cell count function

FeatCellCount <- function(seuratObj){dim(seuratObj)
              }
  
  
##create function for doublet finder 


preDoublets <- function(seuratObj){  
    seuratObj <- NormalizeData(seuratObj)
    
    seuratObj <- ScaleData(seuratObj)
    seuratObj <- FindVariableFeatures(seuratObj, 
                                      x.low.cutoff = 0.0125, 
                                      y.cutoff = 0.25, 
                                      do.plot=FALSE)
    seuratObj <- RunPCA(seuratObj, pc.genes = seuratObj@var.genes, pcs.print = 0)
    
 
    return(seuratObj)
}



findDoublets <- function(seuratObj, n_pcs=30){
    
   
    nExp_poi  <- round(0.15*nrow(seuratObj@meta.data))
    
    print('yay!')
  
    seuratObj <- doubletFinder(seuratObj, 
                                  PCs = 1:30, 
                                  pN = 0.25, 
                                  pK = 0.01, 
                                  nExp = nExp_poi, 
                                  sct=FALSE)
    
    
    
     seuratObj@meta.data <- seuratObj@meta.data %>% 
        rename_at(vars(starts_with("DF.classifications")), 
                  funs(str_replace(., ".*", "DF.classifications"))) %>%
        rename_at(vars(starts_with("pANN")), 
                  funs(str_replace(., ".*", "pANN")))
    
       
  
        return(seuratObj) 
    
}


#create a workbook that contains assigns each clusters data to its own sheet

cluster_workbook <- function(data, n_clusters){
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Markers")
writeData(wb, sheet = "Markers", x = filtered_markers)

  for(i in 0:n_clusters){
    
    cluster_data <- filtered_markers[filtered_markers$cluster == i,] 
    addWorksheet(wb, as.character(i))
    writeData(wb, sheet = as.character(i), x = cluster_data)
    saveWorkbook(wb, file = "filtered_markers.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
    
  }
  
  
}


#top 5 genes for each cluster, sorted largest to smallest for avg log, more than 0.1 for pct.1 and less than 0.05 for p val adj
top5 <- function(sObj){

clusters <- filtered_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% filter(pct.1 > 0.1) %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% top_n(5, avg_log2FC)
  

return(clusters)  
 
   
}

#compare umap plots for 5 resolutions, select the one that provides an accurate representation of the biological data

umap_trial <- function(sObj, resolutions = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1),
                           dims, label.size = 10, repel = TRUE){
  
  plots <- list()
  objects <- list()
  
  for(res in resolutions){
    
    
    objres <- FindClusters(sObj, resolution = res)
    objres <- RunUMAP(objres, dims = dims)
    
    
    
    plots[[as.character(res)]] <- DimPlot(
      objres, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 10, 
      repel = TRUE) + ggtitle(paste0("Resolution = ", res))
    
    objects[[as.character(res)]] <- objres
  }
  return(list(plots = plots, objects = objects))
}




```

#assign cluster identity


```{r}

Idents(HH28B) <- HH28B@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.6

names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(HH28B)

HH28B <- RenameIdents(HH28B, new.cluster.ids)
DimPlot(HH28B, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 8) + xlab("UMAP 1") + ylab("UMAP 2") +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10)))
```

#update how clusters are ordered in metadata to ensure uniform ordering across all sample reports
```{r}
# Update the identity of the Seurat object and define the new order of groups
HH28B@meta.data$Phase <- factor(HH28B@meta.data$Phase, levels = c("G1", "S", "G2M"))


# Reassign identity with the new order
Idents(HH28B) <- HH28B@meta.data$Phase
```
